answer: Make every identity earn its spending limit through a chain of service receipts: a newcomer starts in a small haven where it may only trade tiny amounts, and each completed job verified by an unrelated peer adds one receipt to its chain. The velvet trap for farms is that receipts cannot be self-issued, so a hundred clones need a hundred jobs, and the fable of cheap sock puppets collapses when a clone with no chain tries to move real value, because the network refuses until the work is proven.
